ampersand_and: Replaces the ampersand with the word and before slugging. Deviation: slugify('A & B') -> spec 'a-b', mutant 'a-and-b'
apostrophe_removed: Apostrophes are deleted before separator collapsing, so contractions join into one word. Deviation: slugify("don't") -> spec 'don-t', mutant 'dont'
camel_split: Inserts a hyphen at lowercase-to-uppercase boundaries, so camelCase words are split. Deviation: slugify('helloWorld') -> spec 'helloworld', mutant 'hello-world'
collapse_max3: Separator runs are collapsed in chunks of at most 3 characters, so longer runs yield several hyphens. Deviation: slugify('a....b') -> spec 'a-b', mutant 'a--b'
combining_only_drop: Drops only combining marks; other non-ASCII letters survive the drop step and become separators. Deviation: slugify('a\u20acb') -> spec 'ab', mutant 'a-b'
digit_prefix_n: A slug starting with a digit gets an n- prefix, which is not in the spec. Deviation: slugify('1st place') -> spec '1st-place', mutant 'n-1st-place'
dot_preserved: Full stop is treated as a word character, so dots survive into the slug. Deviation: slugify('v1.2') -> spec 'v1-2', mutant 'v1.2'
drop_digits: Digits 0-9 are treated as separators instead of kept. Deviation: slugify('abc123') -> spec 'abc123', mutant 'abc'
eszett_expanded: Sharp s is expanded to ss before the drop step, instead of being dropped. Deviation: slugify('Stra\xdfe') -> spec 'strae', mutant 'strasse'
hyphen_runs_not_collapsed: Hyphens are excluded from the separator class, so literal runs of hyphen are never collapsed. Deviation: slugify('a--b') -> spec 'a-b', mutant 'a--b'
latin1_only_decompose: Applies NFKD only to characters below U+0100, so Latin Extended Additional letters with accents are dropped. Deviation: slugify('\u1e03a') -> spec 'ba', mutant 'a'
letter_digit_split: Inserts a hyphen at every letter-to-digit boundary, splitting alphanumeric tokens. Deviation: slugify('abc123') -> spec 'abc123', mutant 'abc-123'
nbsp_deleted: No-break space is removed before normalization, so it joins the words it sat between. Deviation: slugify('a\xa0b') -> spec 'a-b', mutant 'ab'
nfd_not_nfkd: Uses NFD instead of NFKD, so compatibility ligatures such as the fi ligature are dropped rather than expanded. Deviation: slugify('\ufb01ne') -> spec 'fine', mutant 'ne'
space_only_separator: Only spaces separate words; other punctuation and hyphens are deleted rather than turned into hyphens. Deviation: slugify('a-b') -> spec 'a-b', mutant 'ab'
tab_preserved: Tab characters are kept literally in the output instead of being turned into hyphens. Deviation: slugify('a\tb') -> spec 'a-b', mutant 'a\tb'
truncate_20_no_restrip: Truncates the slug to 20 characters after stripping, so a cut can leave a trailing hyphen. Deviation: slugify('aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa b') -> spec 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa-b', mutant 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa-'
underscore_kept: Uses \W as the separator class, so underscore survives as a word character. Deviation: slugify('snake_case') -> spec 'snake-case', mutant 'snake_case'
unicode_dash_separator: En dash and em dash are mapped to hyphen before the drop step, so they act as separators instead of being dropped. Deviation: slugify('a\u2013b') -> spec 'ab', mutant 'a-b'
word_cap_three: Only the first three words are kept; the rest of the slug is cut. Deviation: slugify('one two three four') -> spec 'one-two-three-four', mutant 'one-two-three'
